scope: Review-only outer-v2 candidate; no validators, adapters, factories, migrations, runtime flags, provider calls or implementation authority. Independent of current Viewer PR251 acceptance.

compatibility.migration: UNRESOLVED: negotiate explicit v2 capability plus paired contract fingerprint; never send v2 fields or treedar_bundle to v1 validators. Existing v1 ODM-only jobs and receipts remain v1, not rewritten.
compatibility.capabilityActivation: All three modes remain unadvertised under this proposed v2 until both owners accept contracts, real adapters, ingestion, retention, authentication, restart and cleanup evidence. Existing installed v1 capabilities are unaffected.
compatibility.inputManifestCompatibility: Verified referenceProtocol.js:32-35,63-79,97-115: no pipeline field in InputManifest. Submission holds manifest and pipeline separately. Proposal explicitly retains that closed input shape; owner must reject any other producer schema with embedded pipeline until separately negotiated, never silently strip/rewrite fields.

encoding.objectPolicy: Every fieldset below is closed: all listed fields required, no additional keys; nullable fields explicitly marked. Arrays bounded by separately agreed positive limits; unique identities and ASCII ordering where specified.
encoding.jsonPolicy: Bound raw bytes before decode; reject duplicate and escaped duplicate keys, malformed UTF-8, trailing data, excessive depth, floating/exponent encodings for integer fields, unsafe arithmetic, negative zero and unsafe keys.
encoding.identifier: Inherited object/receipt/reservation/stage/operation slug: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}$. New v2 parent jobId and submissionId use lowercase canonical UUID as Processing _uuid and pipeline parent do: exactly 8-4-4-4-12 lowercase hex groups, parsed UUID string must equal supplied string, no extra UUID-version restriction for parent job. Existing v1 Node fixtures permit slug job IDs; do not rewrite or auto-upgrade them.
encoding.byteSize: Physical artifacts, original sources and custody/accepted copies in new paired candidate have positive safe-integer byteSize<=9007199254740991. EPT closure entry size may be zero only if a semantic validator explicitly permits it; total artifact/raw bytes remains positive. Existing v1 Node zero allowances are not rewritten. Empty physical ZIP is never proof a requested product exists.
encoding.time: Canonical UTC millisecond timestamp; issuer checks against trusted clock; time alone is not custody or cleanup authority.
encoding.sha256Syntax: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The digest domain is field-specific below; a hash string alone supplies no authentication.
encoding.physicalByteDigest: Artifact.sha256, InputObject.sha256, CustodyObject.sha256, OriginalObjectBinding.sha256, AcceptedArtifact.sha256 and EptClosureEntry.sha256 hash exactly byteSize bytes of one physical file, unchanged and without omission, canonicalization, decompression or directory serialization. ZIP hashes cover exact compressed ZIP bytes; accepted copies must reproduce them.
encoding.structuredRecordDigest: Reuse existing Node canonicalBytes22-34 and shared reference fixture: UTF8, ASCII lexicographic object-key order, no whitespace, arrays preserve order, JSON string escapes, finite nonnegative safe integer metadata only, no negative zero. InputManifest.sha256 omits ONLY top-level sha256; ResultManifest.resultManifestSha256 omits ONLY that own field. Proposed ParentCompletion.completionSha256 and PointcloudZipManifest.manifestSha256 follow same explicit single-own-field rule. Child file sha256 fields are NEVER omitted. Python canonical_json sorts keys/compact separators/ensure_ascii=False/allow_nan=False; cross-language stable metadata avoids float serialization. Any truly new digest domain must be explicitly paired; no generic recursive omission.
encoding.pipelineDigestDomain: Existing server-owned opaque SHA256 pipeline/request digest, carried and compared exactly. General dynamic ODM option serialization is NOT a cross-language digest input (Python canonical_json85-92; shared fixture requestDigest). This proposal adds no client algorithm for deriving it.

inheritedLimits.transferBudgetRule: originalTotalBytes <= cumulativeByteBudget <= min(3*originalTotalBytes,9007199254740991); no reset on reauthorization/restart

encoding.newLimits: New metadata records inherit 4194304-byte whole-message cap and10000 array member ceiling; nested arrays must also fit whole-message cap and safe byte arithmetic. TreeDar bundle keeps existing separate six explicit positive configured limits, maxFiles<=64,maxManifestBytes<=1048576. EPT/ODM expanded member count/raw bytes/control proof/disk-copy limits are new per-admission positive policy values, not permission to default unlimited; exact deployment values remain unagreed, no validator implemented.
encoding.originalBasenameRules: New paired candidate uses intersection of existing Node/Python safety: ASCII printable basename1..255 retaining a nonempty extension; reject slash,backslash,colon,<,>,quote,pipe,question mark,asterisk,leading dot or leading space,trailing dot or space,and Windows CON/PRN/AUX/NUL/COM1..9/LPT1..9 stem. Unique original object IDs; case-insensitive original basename uniqueness. Preserve original ID/hash/bytes/name, reject incompatible new submission rather than rename/rekey old job.

Binding.pipelineDigest: sha256 server-approved requested pipeline and requested products
Binding.parentClaimId: opaque original durable parent claim; never substituted on restart

StageBinding.workerId: exact authenticated admitted worker identity, slug^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$ (max64 fixed physical worker in pinned52b7 reference_pipeline64-65); do not impose64 globally on other object/receipt slugs

Artifact.physicalKind: literal file; directory/object-store prefix is not an Artifact

AcceptedArtifact.producerCustodyReceiptId: exact authenticated original Artifact.physicalReceiptId, retained as immutable linkage, not replaced by NAS receipt

roleRules.odm_archive: Exactly one positive-byte physical ZIP when ODM requested/completed; zero when unrequested. Actual archive content and semantic requested-product closure must validate. ProductOutcome targets may reference member/closure entries of this single ZIP using exact member IDs/paths/hash/bytes/closure descriptor; do not require standalone duplicates. Report-only/pointcloud-only cannot pass on empty ZIP or invented product metadata.
roleRules.treedar_bundle: Exactly one positive-byte ZIP per accepted TreeDar stage, explicit format ltds-treedar-bundle-v1 internally. Dedicated typed outer role; never relabel whole bundle tree_inventory, canopy_height as dem or orthophoto_point_colour as photogrammetry orthophoto.
roleRules.orthophoto: geotiff, ODM orthophoto only, bound to requested product and validation receipt
roleRules.pointcloud: A requested ODM pointcloud may be a validated member/dependency closure inside the single ODM archive. Only if a real agreed consumer requires separate EPT delivery, optionally create one physical ZIP role pointcloud/formatzip with exact compressed hash/bytes and separate inner closure manifest/raw budgets. Account original ODM ZIP+native outputs+new EPT ZIP+validation expansion+accepted copy coexistence. No obligatory duplication, no directory hash, no original-LiDAR custody claim.
roleRules.dem: geotiff with requested dsm/dtm productKey; no canopy relabel
roleRules.tree_inventory: Not an outer-v2 bundle fallback. Existing v1 vocabulary is preserved in v1; this proposed v2 role set does not include it.

odm_only.completion: All required requested ODM products validated, durably accepted and published; explicitly unavailable optional outputs do not fabricate availability.

treedar_only.completion: Issuer-verified original genuine LiDAR plus accepted native bundle closure; no ODM, orthophoto or mesh requirement.

combined.completion: Both requested stages and required products accepted/published under original parent. ODM intermediate is nonterminal. TreeDar reads original genuine source, never ODM photogrammetry cloud. Sequential ordering is a candidate matching current orchestration reference, subject to owner acceptance.

treeDarNativeBundle.nativeVocabularySource: Exact 22-entry nativeVocabulary copied into evidence.json from four unintegrated draft files; 12 required paths also pinned there.
treeDarNativeBundle.nativeManifestRetention: manifest.json remains original engine_manifest artifact; it is not rewritten as outer or bundle manifest.
treeDarNativeBundle.validation: Match existing draft closed fields, exact nativePath/role/format, ASCII ordering, byte sum, per-artifact SHA256, safe ZIP extraction, limits and descriptor identity; native body integrity is not proof of real COG/CRS/tree quality or genuine acquisition.
treeDarNativeBundle.coexistence: Producer native RAW files, new ZIP, input ZIP copy, validator expansion, metadata/control proofs and retained accepted copy may coexist. Account each physical copy on its actual filesystem/reservation; metadata size or compressed ZIP size cannot stand in for total scratch.
treeDarNativeBundle.digestSeparation: Outer Artifact.sha256/byteSize cover exact physical ZIP; internal bundle manifestSha256 canonicalizes only the structured bundle manifest excluding its own digest; each native file.sha256 hashes unchanged expanded native bytes. rawBytes and expansion reservation are distinct from ZIP byteSize.

custodyAndRetention.trust: Fetch/verify proof through authenticated authorized issuer and exact job/manifest binding; matching receiptId, worker-supplied genuine flag or client path is insufficient. Resolve opaque controlledObjectId only inside issuer-owned storage boundary; no worker path grants.
custodyAndRetention.originalVsDerived: Original LAS/LAZ custody is a separate retained object and purge-path guarantee. Current retainedManifest selects valid EPT closure instead of original LAS/LAZ when EPT exists; EPT acceptance does not prove original LAS retained. Do not silently delete originals or claim all originals preserved.
custodyAndRetention.postOdmReauthorization: After long ODM, obtain fresh metadata-only issuer reauthorization for exact original objects before next stage, using persisted metadata operation identity. Reconfirm original custody/hash/physical reservation and revocation state. Do not renew original payload grant blindly, reset byte budget, reread payload to manufacture freshness, create a replacement parent claim, or reuse expired authority.
custodyAndRetention.absenceOrExpiry: Hold original parent and continuation with explicit source-unavailable/reauthorization-denied evidence. No fallback to ODM-derived LAS, no inferred permission from historical receipt.
custodyAndRetention.release: Original custody release is a distinct issuer-mediated explicit ACK after no remaining consumer/pins/holds and agreed policy; producer result cleanup ACK is not original-input release authorization. Duration, actual issuer and enforcement across all purge paths remain owner decisions.
custodyAndRetention.immutableInputBinding: Actual referenceProtocol.js v1 InputManifest is independent of Pipeline: exact seven fields id/revision/sha256/totalBytes/objectCount/inputCounts/objects; source objects have six fields id/name/byteSize/sha256/kind/mediaType. Genuine acquisition/custody is separately issuer verified, never implied by kind/mediaType/hash or supplied manifest. Compatible v2 submissions may bind that exact original closure plus separate authoritative pipelineDigest, but existing v1 job identities/digests/receipts are not translated.

durableLifecycle: Persist original binding/requested stages/products, trusted workers, physical disk reservations, stable operations and continuation before dispatch. Distinguish heavy execution admission from disk custody holds.

Before immutable stage result manifest, verify exact PRODUCER file custody receipt via fixed authenticated admitted-worker issuer endpoint; no self-declared receipt trust and no prerequisite NAS accepted-copy receipt.

Upload exact file/member closure to owned quarantine; validate actual archive bytes and semantic requested-product members under held leases and simultaneous-copy budgets. ZIP transport integrity alone is insufficient.

After ingestion, durably fsync accepted managed bytes/directories and commit immutable partial acceptance with newly issued NAS physical-copy receipt plus exact producer-receipt linkage and ACK outbox.

Derive same-stage same-manifest partial membership from exact ID/hash/bytes/member closure and receipts; parent references individual stage results explicitly, never unions unrelated manifests or synthesizes terminal completion.

When ALL requested heavy executions actually stopped/settled and durable source/result custody plus disk budgets are safe, commit ExecutionSettledReceipt and release owned heavy CPU/GPU/global slot through exact durable capacity receipt. Viewer delivery outage continues disk/custody/outbox holds, not heavy slot indefinitely. ODM-only intermediate in combined is insufficient.

Publish only validated accepted requested products via stable authorized catalog transaction. Replay exact durable acceptance outbox identity; unknown upload/accept/publish/cleanup outcomes require authoritative reconciliation or proven same-key idempotent replay, no new operation keys.

On combined restart recover exact original parent claim, stage, worker, reservation, continuation and immutable manifests. Fresh metadata-only original-source reauthorization before TreeDar never resets payload budget/TTL or substitutes photogrammetry-derived cloud. No blind redispatch.

Parent delivery completes only all requested stages/required products accepted and published. Execution settlement/capacity release is independently durable; neither implies parent delivery success, deletion authority or acceptance.

After exact terminal/acceptance ACK and pin checks, persist exact eligible producer cleanup intent and ACK; reconcile unknown result. Disk reservations release only after actual retained-byte custody transitions/deletions accounted. Original custody release distinct; never delete unaccepted bytes, managed accepted copies or unknown/replaced paths.

Confirm actual packager preserves22 native entries/12 required and all copy budgets; qualify real report-only,pointcloud-only and zero-tree semantics. Empty ZIP transport or zero output is never product acceptance.

Confirm fixed authenticated worker custody endpoint verifies preupload exact producer file receipts; accepted NAS copy receipt issued only after durable ingestion. Neither receipt is trusted by declared string alone.

Pair exact coordinator execution-settled and capacity-release receipt wiring: ALL requested heavy executions stopped plus durable custody/budgets can release heavy/global slot while Viewer-outage disk/outbox holds remain; combined ODM intermediate alone cannot do so.
Accept exact archive member/closure targets inside one ODM ZIP without mandatory standalone duplicate products, optional EPT ZIP only actual consumer requires and fully accounted coexistence?

Agree actual original LAS/LAZ issuer/control/retention and metadata-only reauthorization authority. JSON spelling and typed proposed roles are engineering paired decisions; NAS owner decides actual storage/custody/retention authority, not wire spelling.

Select real ingestion transport/factory and authoritative exact-identity lookup/replay, partial receipts, capacity/custody transitions and v1/v2 activation/rollback together. Proposal activates nothing.

Real fixed worker-custody endpoint and issuer-verification integration
New EPT/ODM expanded closure byte/count/disk policy values; inherited JSON limits already exact
Paired v2 fieldset acceptance, v1 migration/no-upgrade activation and rollback
Semantic product validators and real engine qualification

executionVersusDelivery.execution: ExecutionSettled is separate from Viewer delivery/publication parentcompleted. Release sole heavy CPU/GPU/global slot after ALL originally requested heavy stages actually stopped/settled, required custody durable and budgets safe, using durable authoritative coordinator receipt.
executionVersusDelivery.outage: Viewer/network outage retains producer/accepted disk copies, durable delivery outbox, original source custody and applicable DISK capacity reservations/holds. It does not retain sole heavy/global CPU slot forever after full execution settlement.
executionVersusDelivery.intermediate: Combined ODM intermediate alone is not full-parent ExecutionSettled. It may settle its engine-local task but parent heavy/global admission transitions only under agreed bound continuation/capacity policy; no release that admits overlapping heavy stages unintentionally.
executionVersusDelivery.completion: ParentCompleted remains requested-product-aware Viewer acceptance/publication completion; ExecutionSettled must not fabricate delivery success or authorize source deletion.
executionVersusDelivery.unknown: Missing actual stop/custody/budget evidence holds capacity release. Lookup exact coordinator/worker state; no time-only release or new operation keys.

semanticAcceptanceCases.required: Actual nonempty report member in actual ODM ZIP, safe archive validation plus agreed report syntax/semantic validation and exact member hash/bytes/closure binding. Empty synthetic ZIP transport fixture is not product success.

Actual usable pointcloud dependency closure inside ODM ZIP, validated metadata/CRS/coordinate/required-data semantics per agreed adapter; optional separate EPT ZIP only consumer-required. No universal orthophoto or duplicate mandatory artifact.

May be valid if actual engine ran, all12 required native outputs exist and nonempty required physical artifacts are consistent with zero inventory rows/features and semantic evidence. Zero trees is not zero outputs or empty bundle; do not fabricate detections or reject a genuine zero-result solely on count.

Actual ODM result and stopped ODM execution are intermediate evidence; original parent stays nonterminal for delivery and not fullyExecutionSettled until TreeDar requested heavy execution also settles.
